selection: Fixed before classifier development: exclude prior diagnostic raw IDs and body-feature duplicates/conflicts; original easy_ham/spam for training; hard_ham first half train/next quarter validation/rest holdout; new cohorts first256 pergroup validation/rest holdout. SHA256 order, no predictions used.

policy.scope: actual production MIME parser, intake/assessment, serialized scorer RPC adapter and routing policy; no mailbox mutation

release.scope: Observed diagnostic/validation/old holdout REGRESSION ONLY; independent acceptance still required

limits: Original holdout was observed before model redesign; it is regression evidence, not independent acceptance.
SpamAssassin corpus dates to 2003 and is not representative of a current mailbox; frozen HTML-only strata describe bounded extraction, not rendered visibility.
Inspection completeness and classification uncertainty are separate. Retained mail is not classified safe.
Unavailable spam remains a routing miss; unavailable counts are also reported separately.
No training, threshold tuning, mail sending, DNS/auth replay or production accuracy claim.
